findings.issue: Task 7 changes TelegramUpdate.callback_query from JsonNode to typed CallbackQuery DTO, but the existing parameterized test `nonMessageJsonNodeSlot_writesUpdateOther_noStubs` includes 'callback_query' in its `jsonNodeSlots()` stream (ProcessTelegramUpdateJobTest.java line 350). After the Task 7 change, the slotPayload('callback_query') will produce a non-null typed CallbackQuery object on the update, causing dispatch() to route into the new callback branch (not logEventOther). The test expects telegram_update_other but a CONNECTED bot is seeded in @BeforeEach, so the callback branch will call advanceOnCallback instead — the test will fail. The task does not mention removing 'callback_query' from jsonNodeSlots() or migrating this case to a typed test.
findings.fix: In step 6 (ProcessTelegramUpdateJobTest), explicitly instruct removing 'callback_query' from the jsonNodeSlots() stream and adding a dedicated test for the case where a typed CallbackQuery payload with a missing/invalid structure results in a bot-lookup miss. Add a note in the AC: 'callback_query removed from jsonNodeSlots() stream; existing parameterized test updated'.

findings.issue: FunnelTriggerService interface (the dependency from Task 5) does NOT yet have advanceOnCallback() — the current interface only declares fire() and cancelActiveFor(). The TDD Anchor instructs writing tests with `verify(funnelTriggerService, times(1)).advanceOnCallback(...)`, but for Mockito @MockitoSpyBean to work at compile time, the method must exist on the interface. The task declares depends_on:[5], which is correct, but the task description says 'Підтвердити точну сигнатуру з FunnelTriggerService.java після Task 5 (зчитати перед написанням)' — however, the TDD Anchor is written before Task 5 exists, so the test must compile only after Task 5. This is a TDD ordering issue: TDD Anchor tests cannot be written (and run red) before Task 5 adds the method.
findings.fix: Add an explicit note in the TDD Anchor section: 'Compile-gate — these tests require Task 5 to have added advanceOnCallback() to FunnelTriggerService first. TDD cycle starts AFTER Task 5 is done (wave ordering ensures this). Do not attempt to write tests before Task 5 is merged.' This makes the dependency constraint explicit for the implementer.
